inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium wide shot of a contemporary property appraiser and a bank surveyor inspecting an underoccupied office floor. One measures floor space with a handheld laser device, while the other compares rental records and photographs empty units for a valuation report. Practical inspection of usable property, no construction damage.
